sloka: तथा प्रोत्साहिता देवी गता मन्थरया सह ।क्रोधागारं विशालाक्षी सौभाग्यमदगर्विता ॥२-९-५५॥
transliteration: tathā protsāhitā devī gatā mantharayā saha ।krodhāgāraṁ viśālākṣī saubhāgyamadagarvitā ॥2-9-55॥

translations.english: That beautiful, largeeyed Kaikeyi, puffed with the pride of her intoxicating beauty, encourged and influenced by the words of that hunchback, entered the chamber of wrath. She cast off her highly precious pearl necklace worth many hundreds of thousands (of rupees) and other costly, beautiful ornaments. Thereafter that goldenhued Kaikeyi lay down on the floor and said to Manthara:
translations.hindi: आाडायास्तस्विदानीं ते लक्ष्य बिपरीतवत्‌ । कुतो वा ते भयं जातं या त्वमेवंविधं वरम्‌ ॥५८]] बाल्यावस्था में तो तेरा स्वभाव इस समय क्के से सवथा विपरीत था । तुझे ऐसा भय कैसे उत्प परिस सबेथा न्न हुआ बर मागती है कि
